- `is_on(name)`: "Return True if the named flag is enabled; undeclared flags are False."
- `all_flags()`: "Return a copy of all flags declared in flags.toml."

The `is_on` docstring mentions that flags missing from `flags.toml` come back as False without any error. The project's existing flag-usage note warns about this, so callers will now see it too.
